attempt: repo audit without verified canonical tree/provenance
cause: specific symbols and line references were produced without verification against the canonical tree
lesson: for repository audits, verify the canonical tree and provenance before trusting specific code claims

attempt: fresh canonical checkout plus tree verification and mandatory provenance
lesson: canonical source verification plus provenance converted the same audit role from unreliable to useful

context.explicit_user_goal: make native Firefox menu simpler and more understandable

attempt: added explanatory descriptions to the FILUM sidebar instead of simplifying the native Firefox menu
cause: the implementation optimized an easier adjacent surface rather than the exact surface named by the requirement
lesson: when a requirement names a specific interaction surface, success must be demonstrated on that surface; adjacent improvements do not satisfy the requirement unless explicitly approved

context.mandatory_acceptance_behavior: contextual notification when a site protection is triggered

attempt: implemented the per-site engine and manual panel but reported the task as complete without the requested contextual notification path
cause: an adjacent fallback was treated as completion instead of being reported as a remaining gap
lesson: for delegated work, completion must be tied to explicit mandatory acceptance criteria; an adjacent fallback is partial unless explicitly approved, and a claimed platform limitation must be supported by concrete technical evidence
